title: AG60102: Tractor Ergonomics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Ergonomic principles. Man-machine system, tractor reliability. Fatigue in
tractor operation. Energy cost of tractor operation. Tractor operator’s working
environment. Thermal stresses in tractor operation. Operator workplace design.
Vibrator and noise: evaluation, reduction, application in tractor seat design.
Biomedical aspects of tractor operation; Visual perception in tractor control
panel design. Principle and design of ROPS, International standards and testing
of ROPS. Computer application and automation in tractor design.
